spec.title: Change Map Product Docs and Map Engineering Docs icons to green play button
spec.context: Users should mentally associate play button icons with commands/actions. The current icons on "Map Product Docs" (book) and "Map Engineering Docs" (symbol-structure) don't communicate that these are runnable commands. The green play button visual language already exists in the codebase for primary actions (ActionItem in tasks-view), creating a clear pattern: green play button = executable command.

scope.in-scope: - Update DocsActionItem class to support ThemeColor parameter - Change "Map Product Docs" icon from "book" to green play button - Change "Map Engineering Docs" icon from "symbol-structure" to green play button
scope.out-of-scope: - Changing icons for DocsFolderItem or DocsFileItem - Modifying any behavior of the action items (commands remain unchanged) - Adding icons to other parts of the extension

spec.requirements: - FR1: The DocsActionItem constructor shall accept an optional ThemeColor parameter for icon coloring - FR2: The "Map Product Docs" action item shall display a green play icon using ThemeIcon('play', ThemeColor('charts.green')) - FR3: The "Map Engineering Docs" action item shall display a green play icon using ThemeIcon('play', ThemeColor('charts.green'))

files.file: Update DocsActionItem constructor signature to accept optional ThemeColor, and change both action item instantiations to use green play icon

patterns.pattern: The established pattern for green play buttons: new vscode.ThemeIcon('play', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.green')) Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:189

research.product: - vscode/kanban-view: Documents Global Actions section. States that green play button pattern is used for primary actions (ActionItems). Current icons are book and symbol-structure.
research.engineering: - systems/vscode-extension: TreeItem types documentation. DocsActionItem uses ThemeIcon without ThemeColor. ActionItem uses the green play pattern we need to adopt.
research.codebase: - DocsActionItem class (docs-view.capability.ts:12-27): Constructor takes iconName string and creates ThemeIcon(iconName) without color - productActionItem instantiation (line 204-208): Uses 'book' icon - engineeringActionItem instantiation (line 209-213): Uses 'symbol-structure' icon - ActionItem class (tasks-view.capability.ts:188-189): Uses ThemeIcon('play', ThemeColor('charts.green')) for primary actions
research.pitfalls: - DocsActionItem constructor lacks ThemeColor support: Modify constructor signature to accept optional ThemeColor parameter alongside iconName

spec.constraints: - Must use VSCode ThemeIcon and ThemeColor APIs per design directive (no hardcoded colors) - Must follow existing capability-computer architecture

risk.mitigation: TypeScript compiler will catch any type errors

risks.risk: Constructor signature change could affect any other callers of DocsActionItem
